key_findings: miRNA-let7b5p is downregulated in the spinal cord of IBS-like rats; restoring it suppresses M1 microglia via MAP3K3 and relieves visceral hypersensitivity.
Activated microglia selectively engulf inhibitory synapses, reducing GABA, VGAT and GAD65/67.
